findings.message: Row 1, column Option1 name: this file has Variant SKU, Variant Price, Variant Inventory Qty without both Option1 name and Option1 value. This matters when you overwrite or update: a new default variant is created and existing variants are deleted.
Row 9, column Tags: tag "PA+PE" contains a symbol. Tags should use letters, numbers, and hyphens, and should avoid accented characters and symbols.
